page.content:
The Fool on the Hill is a song by The Beatles written by Paul McCartney (credited to Lennon/McCartney) which was recorded in 1967. It was included on the Magical Mystery Tour album and in the film of the same name.

page.overview:
What is The Fool on the Hill?

The Fool on the Hill is a song by The Beatles written by Paul McCartney (credited to Lennon/McCartney) which was recorded in 1967. It was included on the Magical Mystery Tour album and in the film of the same name.
